title: This woman found in Ranchi, PM Modi, Rahul Gandhi, BJP and Congress told everyone
description: During the coverage of Jharkhand Election 2019, the team of 'The Lallantop' interacted with some daily wage workers in Ranchi's Lalpur chowk. We talked about Jharkhand assembly poll, PM Narendra Modi and Mgnrega.  During our conversation, we came to know that life is not easy for these labourers. Apart from this, in Mgnrega, they are not paid well. The life of daily wage workers is full of struggles as they travel 20 km every day to Ranchi to earn their daily wage. When asked about the government and political parties, the labourers showed their unhappiness with PM Modi, Rahul Gandhi, and other political parties' leaders. Watch the video to know what these labourers said about our political leaders like Narendra Modi, Rahul Gandhi etc.   Install The Lallantop Android App: https://thelallantop.app.link/zCSsHooQSU  Follow us on: https://www.instagram.com/thelallantop/  Like The Lallantop on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/thelallantop/  Follow The Lallantop on Twitter: https://twitter.com/TheLallantop  For advertisements e-mail us at: [EMAIL]  Produced By: The Lallantop Edited By: Amitesh
